"''I'm here, trooper. Sterling, isn't it?|Sterling and Ahsoka Tano|}} '''Sterling''' was the nickname of a [[clone trooper]] of the [[332nd Division]] within the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[501st Legion]] who took part in the [[Siege of Mandalore]] in [[19 BBY]]. During the siege, Sterling and his unit traveled to reinforce [[C-deck]] in the [[Undercity]] of the [[planet]] [[Mandalore]]'s [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Sundari]], but they were ambushed by renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]]. While fighting in the ambush, Sterling was wounded by a [[blaster]] hit to the torso, and his unit sustained heavy casualties. Sterling reported to the division's military [[advisor]], [[Ahsoka Tano]], about the ambush and informed her that [[Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Jesse]] had been taken hostage by Maul. ==Biography== {{Quote|Maul, he— ''[coughs]'' he went through us, one by one. He was asking about you.|Sterling and Ahsoka Tano|}} Sterling was a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[Jango Fett]] and was [[Reproduction|born]] on the [[Planet|world]] of [[Kamino]]. In the final [[Standard day|days]] of the [[The galaxy|galactic]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] known as the [[Clone Wars]]''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' in [[19 BBY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[The Phantom Apprentice]]" to [[19 BBY]]. Sterling was part of the [[332nd Division]], which conducted the [[Siege of Mandalore|siege]] of the planet [[Mandalore]] under the leadership of the newly appointed [[Clone Commander]] [[Rex]] alongside former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], who acted as an [[advisor]].{{TCW|Old Friends Not Forgotten}} Sterling was among the [[clone trooper]]s who successfully landed at Mandalore's [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Sundari]], where he also participated in and survived the opening skirmishes against rogue [[Mandalorian super commando]]s. Sometime later, Sterling's unit was sent with [[Advanced Recon Commando]] [[Clone Lieutenant]] [[Jesse]] to reinforce [[C-deck]] in Sundari's [[Undercity]], but they were ambushed by renegade [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], who brutally cut through the [[Grand Army of the Republic|Republic forces]]. Sterling was wounded by a [[blaster]] shot to his chest, though he survived, unlike most of the unit, which sustained heavy casualties. Sterling also witnessed Maul capturing Jesse after he had determined through the use of a [[The Force|Force]] [[Mind probe (Force power)|mind probe]] that the clone was older than the rest of his unit. [[File:Sterling_Talk.png|thumb|left|300px|An injured Sterling is comforted by Ahsoka Tano.]] Shortly after, Ahsoka Tano was informed of Maul's attack and quickly made her way to the site of the skirmish alongside [[Commander]] Rex. Upon seeing her, Sterling, who was supported by a fellow clone and was sitting against a wall in pain from his injuries, summoned Tano to him, respectfully addressing her as "Commander" despite her lack of [[military rank]]. He explained to her what had occurred, recounting Maul's ferocity, and he reached out and grabbed her arm as he emphasized that Maul had taken Jesse captive. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|The ARC Trooper, Jesse. Maul realized he was older, somehow, looked in his mind… ''[coughs]'' and he took him. He took Jesse alive!|Sterling, to Ahsoka Tano|}} As with the other clones of Jango Fett, Sterling stood 1.83 [[meter]]s tall (6 [[Foot|ft]]) and weighed eighty [[kilogram]]s. He had [[Color|brown]] [[eye]]s, tan skin, and sported a short black [[hair]]cut. Sterling addressed Ahsoka Tano with her former military rank, befitting her status as a former Jedi and leader of the clones. Sterling insisted that Tano needed to know what happened when Maul attacked. ==Equipment== At birth, like the other clone [[trooper]]s, Sterling was implanted by the [[Kaminoan]] [[scientist]]s with a [[behavioral modification biochip]] to ensure that the trooper would not resist certain [[Executive Order Codes for the Grand Army of the Republic|orders]]. Sterling was equipped with a set of [[Phase II clone trooper armor]], which along with that of other troopers of the 332nd Division of the [[501st Legion]] was decorated to match Tano's [[Togruta]] coloration and [[lekku]] markings. ==Behind the scenes== Sterling appeared in "[[The Phantom Apprentice]]," the tenth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''{{'}} [[The Clone Wars: Season Seven|seventh and final season]], voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]] like all other clones in the episode. The episode was released on [[April 24]], [[2020]], on the [[Disney+]] platform,{{Disney|subdomain=dmedmedia|url=disney-plus/star-wars-the-clone-wars/710|text=Episode 710 "The Phantom Apprentice"}} although Sterling had been featured in a preview clip of the episode that was released on [[April 14]] of that year on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[Wikipedia:YouTube|YouTube]] channel.{{SWYouTube|TyHcqX2lQWI|Star Wars: The Clone Wars | "The Phantom Apprentice" Clip | Disney+|sw_url=video/the-phantom-apprentice}} ==Appearances== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Sterling}} *{{TCW|The Phantom Apprentice}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|TyHcqX2lQWI|Star Wars: The Clone Wars | "The Phantom Apprentice" Clip | Disney+|sw_url=video/the-phantom-apprentice}} {{1stp}} *{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/the-phantom-apprentice-episode-guide|text="The Phantom Apprentice" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Sterling |ja=スターリング |nl=Sterling |pl=Sterling |tr=Sterling }} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Members of the 501st Legion (Galactic Republic)]]
